summary:
標普全球本季 EPS 大超預期15%，營收年增10%，評級與指數業務雙引擎強勁。
• EPS 4.69 美元，較預估4.06大幅超出15.48%。
• 營收4.17億美元（B級），年增10.43%維持雙位數。
• 評級（Ratings）業務隨債券發行回暖明顯受惠。
• 指數與市場情報業務提供穩定經常性收入。
ai_view:
訊號正面：EPS 大幅超預期且營收雙位數成長，反映債券發行回暖帶動評級業務，加上指數與市場情報的經常性收入結構穩固。短期股價有業績支撐，中期關鍵在發債循環持續性與市場情報訂閱續約率。追蹤指標：評級分部營收與發行量、指數資產規模（AUM 連動）、訂閱續約率與營業利潤率。27倍本益比合理，業務組合具防禦與成長兼具特性。

需留意：債券發行量對利率高度敏感，評級營收循環性強。；資本市場活動放緩將直接衝擊高利潤業務。；本益比27對成長放緩較敏感。

summary_en:
S&P Global smashed EPS by 15% with 10% revenue growth, driven by strong ratings and indices.
• EPS of $4.69 beat the $4.06 estimate by 15.48%.
• Revenue of $4.17B grew 10.43% year over year, staying double-digit.
• Ratings clearly benefited from a rebound in bond issuance.
• Indices and market intelligence provide stable recurring revenue.

ai_view_en:
Signal is positive: a large EPS beat with double-digit revenue growth reflects a ratings tailwind from recovering issuance, plus a solid recurring base from indices and market intelligence. Near-term the stock has earnings support; mid-term hinges on issuance-cycle durability and market-intelligence renewals. Track ratings revenue and issuance volumes, index-linked AUM, renewal rates, and operating margin. A 27x P/E is fair for a mix that balances defense and growth.

Watch：Issuance volumes are rate-sensitive, making ratings revenue cyclical.; A slowdown in capital-markets activity would directly hit high-margin segments.; A P/E of 27 is sensitive to slowing growth.
beat_or_miss: 超預期：EPS 較預估高出15.48%，營收年增10.43%動能穩健。
